title: A place to capture light
hook: Inspect the cell and find the structure behind its function.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Chloroplasts contain thylakoid membranes, where light-dependent photosynthetic reactions occur. Plant cells also have mitochondria, including in photosynthetic tissues.
